confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief to confirm whether LH-02 is actually stopped at C512-06 (radio says stopped, CMMS says operating). No loader moved from or to this place until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C564-14 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 13:30, so the stope would sit idle with 134 t at 12.1 g/t, about 52 oz. LH-09 (LH410, 29.1 t/h) is 0.34 h away at DS-C564-02, in the same mine. It would clear the 134 t in about 4.6 h. Cost is about 1.5 oz/h x ~5 h, roughly 8 oz. Central has 174 t in the stockpile against a 450 t capacity, and the inflow of about 107 t/h only slightly exceeds truck capacity of 91 t/h, so this is acceptable. DS-N522-01 is farther away (0.71 h) and its LH-08 is cheaper, but a 0.71 h trip costs more production, so I chose LH-09. LH-02's status conflict is unresolved, so by CONFIRM-01 nothing is moved there and I asked for confirmation. No stope is stopped, so no reserve is activated.
